tools.name: compare_robot_types
tools.description: Compare two robot categories side by side: 2026 rental and purchase price ranges plus their typical use cases. Read-only.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Get the full public profile for ONE robot company by its slug (e.g. "dma-events"). Returns description, robot types, use cases, location, partner tier, verified/claimed status, website, profile URL, and its robot listings (paid tiers). Read-only.

slug.description: Company slug from a profile URL, e.g. "dma-events" (the part after /companies/).

tools.name: get_directory_stats
tools.description: Get live directory totals: number of published companies, robot listings, and distinct countries served. Read-only.

tools.name: get_robot_pricing
tools.description: Return verified 2026 market price ranges (daily rental and purchase, USD) for robot categories. Pass robot_type for one category, or omit to get the whole table. Estimates only — actual quotes come from companies via an inquiry. Read-only.

robot_type.description: Category to price, e.g. humanoid, service, delivery, security, cleaning, entertainment, educational, medical_surgical, warehouse, agricultural, drone_aerial, greeter, telepresence, quadruped. Omit for all.

tools.name: list_robot_types
tools.description: List the robot categories in the directory that have editorial guide pages, each with its /robot-types/ page URL, the search filter value, and its 2026 price range. Read-only.

tools.name: list_use_cases
tools.description: List the use-case categories with their /use-cases/ guide page URLs and the value to pass as use_case to search_robot_companies. Read-only.

tools.name: prepare_inquiry
tools.description: STEP 1 of 2 (no send). Validate an inquiry and resolve the target company, then return a human-readable summary of exactly what would be sent. It does NOT submit anything and captures no name/email. The agent MUST show this summary to the user and get explicit confirmation before calling submit_inquiry. Inputs: company_slug, inquiry_type (rent|buy), robot_type (accepted enum), event_location (city/region + timing), and an optional message.

inquiry_type.description: Whether the buyer wants to rent or buy.

robot_type.description: Robot category — must be an accepted enum value (call list_robot_types / get_robot_pricing for names; strict values include humanoid, delivery, security, cleaning, service_hospitality, medical_surgical, warehouse, agricultural, entertainment, educational).

event_location.description: Where/when the robot is needed, e.g. "Toronto, Canada — Aug 2026".

message.description: Optional note describing the buyer's needs.

tools.name: search_robot_companies
tools.description: Search the BuyAndRentRobots directory of robot COMPANIES. Filter by robot type, use case, and/or country. Returns company name, robot types offered, location, partner tier, verified status, and a profile link. Read-only.

robot_type.description: Category, e.g. humanoid, delivery, service, security, cleaning, entertainment, educational, medical_surgical, agricultural, greeter, telepresence, quadruped, industrial.

use_case.description: Use, e.g. events, hotels, restaurants, retail, healthcare, education, logistics (warehouses).

tools.name: search_robots
tools.description: Search individual ROBOT listings in the BuyAndRentRobots directory. Filter by robot type and/or country. Returns each robot's name, type, availability, and the company offering it with a profile link. Read-only. (Note: this endpoint does not filter by use case.)

robot_type.description: Category, e.g. humanoid, delivery, service, security, cleaning, entertainment, educational, greeter, telepresence, quadruped, industrial.

country.description: Country name to filter the offering company by.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: STEP 2 of 2 — SENDS a real inquiry (a lead). Call this ONLY after prepare_inquiry AND after the user has reviewed the prepared summary and explicitly confirmed. Requires the buyer's REAL name, a valid email, a message, and the confirmed target (company_slug, inquiry_type, robot_type, event_location). NEVER invent or default the name or email — if you don't have them from the user, ask first. Agent-submitted inquiries are NOT sent to any company directly (not even Verified partners): they are routed to the BuyAndRentRobots team (info@) for manual review and forwarding. The endpoint rate-limits agent inquiries to 3 per hour and rejects missing/invalid name, email, message, or an unknown target company.

customer_name.description: Buyer's real full name (provided by the user).

customer_email.description: Buyer's real email (provided by the user).

message.description: The inquiry message describing what the buyer needs.

event_location.description: Confirmed where/when the robot is needed.
